en.title: Dolls Remaining After Nesting
en.description: Put smaller dolls inside larger ones; dolls of the same size cannot nest inside each other. After nesting as much as possible, output the minimum number of dolls left.
en.input: The input gives N (1≤N≤100000), then a line of N sizes (1..100000).
en.output: Output the answer as described; for array answers, separate values with spaces.
en.explanation:
Count the occurrences of each size; the answer is the maximum frequency.

Correctness: each size appears at most once in any nesting chain, so the most frequent size needs at least that many chains. Conversely, sort the sizes and assign them round-robin by index to that many chains; sizes within each chain strictly increase, so every doll fits into a chain.

Complexity: O(N) time, O(N) space.
hints: Count the occurrences of each size; the answer is the maximum frequency.
